experiment_data.hypothesis: Narrow dual-critic ablation (2×256 hidden, total params ≈ baseline single 512 critic): isolates min operation effect from parameter count. If CIVO suppressed → min operation itself prevents overestimation cascade. If CIVO persists → parameter count is the key factor. Combined with exp_033 (wide single critic) forms 2×2 factorial: {single,dual} × {normal,scaled} → mechanism decomposition.
